description.zh: 删除模版时，顺带删除其相关的执行。
description.en: Specifies whether to delete the related executions when the template is deleted.

description.zh: 模板名称。内容限制为字母、数字、中划线、下划线，长度200字符，且不能以ALIYUN、ACS、ALIBABA、ALICLOUD开头。
description.en: The name of the template. The name can be up to 200 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_). The name cannot start with ALIYUN, ACS, ALIBABA, or ALICLOUD.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oos delete-template --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --template-name MyTemplate --auto-delete-executions false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oos DeleteTemplate --region cn-hangzhou --AutoDeleteExecutions false --TemplateName MyTemplate --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
